newsitem.title: FRANCE: RUGBY UNION-PENAUD, TOURNAIRE RETURN AGAINST ENGLAND.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-PENAUD, TOURNAIRE RETURN AGAINST ENGLAND.

text.p: France picked the Brive half-back partnership of Philippe Carbonneau and Alain Penaud for their crunch Five Nations meeting with England at Twickenham on Saturday.
Penaud missed the home victory over Wales two weeks ago through injury but was passed fit after coming through Brive's north-south clash with Auckland last weekend unscathed.
French coach Jean-Claude Skrela was clearly impressed by the New Zealanders' performance against the European club champions.
"Individual and collective defence is going to be one of the keys of the England match. We must emulate the Auckland players who are very good at this," he said.
It may be why Penaud was preferred to David Aucagne of Pau, who impressed when he went on as a substitute for the injured Richard Dourthe during the match against the Welsh at the Parc des Princes.
Prop Franck Tournaire is also back in the side after a one match suspension for violent play during France's opening game in Dublin last month when they beat Ireland. Jean-Louis Jordana steps down.
The team has altogether three changes in personnel, with Olivier Magne preferred to injured Richard Castel in the back row, and one positional.
Magne wins his second cap after coming on in the 57th minute as replacement for lock Hugues Miorin against Wales.
The positional change sees Christophe Lamaison stepping back into the three-quarters, where he replaces Dourthe, to make way at fly-half for Penaud.

"Last year, we beat the English with an experienced team. This team is younger but it will be a good test for them. We beat them the last two times we met them so we are going to Twickenham without pressure," said Skrela.
But he admitted the match was special.
"I have not seen so much concentration and motivation from the players in over a year," he said.

Team: 15-Jean-Luc Sadourny; 14-Laurent Leflamand, 13-Christophe Lamaison, 12-Stephane Glas, 11-David Venditti; 10-Alain Penaud, 9-Philippe Carbonneau; 7-Olivier Magne, 8-Fabien Pelous, 6-Abdelatif Benazzi (captain), 5-Hugues Miorin, 4-Olivier Merle, 3-Franck Tournaire, 2-Marc Dal Maso, 1-Christian Califano.
